baseline.exits: original plan stop / MA20 / profit lock / stop-loss only

change.definition: From entry-day close, track the max close on market sessions strictly before original exit. A hole, nonpositive volume, or one-price limit-down on the fill session does not roll; keep the original exit. Do not read bars after 2022-12-31 for training.

metric.primary: independent win_rate, profit_factor, avg_pnl vs the same 474 original-exit pnls
metric.validation_if_keep: same overlay on 2023-2026 completed fills, labeled exposure
